methods.note: The text supports HotSpot 6.0 steady grid, PrimeTime power extraction, Eq. 3 traffic scaling and Black's model (pp. 2-5). Equations 4-5 are garbled in the extracted text. The extraction record labels the experiment kind custom_2d_steady while also stating steady_2d_relevant=false and listing essential 3D mismatches (TSV and bonding layers, per-layer results, heat sink on top). That labeling contradicts the paper's 3D method.

code.note: No code repository or pinned asset exists. The flow uses proprietary Synopsys DC/ICC/PrimeTime plus HotSpot 6.0, and C++/Python/Bash scripts are mentioned but not released (p.10). The linked URLs are third-party references only and are not evidence of code.

parameters.note: Table 3 values and Table 2 values were found on pp.7-8 and are correctly normalized. The paper contradicts itself on static power (7.64e-4 W in Table 2 vs 7.66e-4 W in text) and on energy per bit (9.2546e-13 in Table 2 vs 9.246e-13 in text). The Table 2 area of 38,838 um^2 does not reconcile with the 290x290 um (84,100 um^2) footprint. The TSV area of 35,700 um^2 / 10.16% is of unstated scope and does not reconcile with the footprint. The extraction itself flags these inconsistencies. No same-scenario per-router power exists for any floorplan block.

config.note: The HotSpot 6.0 configuration is not published: heat sink, convection, ambient, layer thicknesses, grid resolution and die size are all absent. Router x/y coordinates, the 3x3x3 stack geometry and the Monolithic variant's layer parameters are not given. No config asset was supplied. The extraction's claim that Figures 2 and 4 contain no coordinates was not verified visually.

data.note: The only numeric thermal observable in text is 351.64 K (78.49 C), the Monolithic maximum on p.9; the arithmetic 78.49+273.15 is correct. Figures 8 and 10, which carry the per-router powers and per-layer temperatures, were not supplied as images, since only pdftotext output and no assets exist. The extraction.experiment floorplan and power_w are empty. The benchmark that produces 351.64 K is unnamed. No digitization was verified.

findings.reason: The experiment is labeled custom_2d_steady although the paper's decisive setup is a 3x3x3 TSV/Monolithic stack with bonding layers and per-layer temperatures, and the extraction itself says steady_2d_relevant=false. This must not be treated as a 2D reproduction.
findings.locator: extraction.experiment vs scenario.steady_2d_relevant; PDF p.8 Table 3, p.9 Figure 10

findings.reason: The floorplan and power_w are empty, so no block has same-scenario power. No router coordinates are published, and any generated 2D shelf coordinates or constant power rows would be illustrative assumptions, not published placement or traces.
Internal paper contradiction: Table 2 gives 7.64e-4 W, while the Section 4.1 text gives 7.66e-4 W. Neither can be preferred without a source; the extraction records both as conflicting.
findings.locator: PDF p.7 Table 2 and Section 4.1 paragraph

findings.reason: Table 2 gives 9.2546e-13 J/bit, while the text gives 9.246e-13. The Table 2 energy of 2.9022496e-8 J divided by 31360 bits gives 9.2546e-13, which supports the table, but the discrepancy is unresolved in the paper.

The synthesized area of 38,838 um^2 does not match the 290x290 um (84,100 um^2) floorplan in Table 3. The logic of 220x220 um at 80% utilization is also not reconciled with either figure. The physical placement area basis is unsupported.
findings.locator: PDF p.7 Table 2 vs p.8 Table 3

findings.reason: The TSV area of 35,700 um^2 and 10.16% has unknown scope (per router or per layer) and cannot be verified against the footprint. Using it for geometry would be an unsupported assumption.

The number is text-supported, but the benchmark and layer are not named in the text, and the surrounding TSV-vs-Monolithic comparison depends on Figure 10, which was not visually verified in the supplied evidence. The decisive per-layer values and the hottest-TSV-equals-coolest-Monolithic claim remain unquantified.
findings.locator: PDF p.9 Section 4.2 text and Figure 10

findings.reason: Figures 7 and 8 are not rendered in the supplied evidence, and the extraction digitizes nothing. The per-router power basis (min/max versus per-router values) cannot be confirmed.
HotSpot 6.0 boundary conditions, heat sink and layer stack parameters are missing, so the solver setup cannot be matched. This is an essential missing input.
The assets list is empty, and linked URLs are third-party references (patent, handbooks, NanGate, FreePDK3D45) rather than code or data for this work. A bare URL is not evidence.

The DVFS scaling equations 4-5 are not legible in the extracted text, and the extraction relies on them for the 2 GHz PARSEC scaling claim. This is unverified for the synthetic case; the 500 MHz point is unaffected.
